title: Lower Bounds for Hamiltonian Mass
exact_target: Prove lower bounds on the Hamiltonian mass of globally well-behaved initial data satisfying the stated positivity assumptions.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30005855 (OWR-14298170-008). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Analysis, Geometry and Topology of Positive Scalar Curvature Metrics (2024), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2024/9, pp. 483--566. Original report and mathematical context. Incorporated report material remains under the source CC BY-SA 4.0 terms unless otherwise noted.

status_qualification: Globally well-behaved and the allowed asymptotic symmetries require the report's precise hypotheses; asymptotically flat and asymptotically anti-de Sitter charges should not be interchanged.
